text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: Did you not get enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Actually... there's an overseas 
race that I just can't afford to miss.
choice_data_list: もしかして、あまり寝れなかった？
choice_data_list_en: Did you not sleep very well, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
There's a time difference between Japan 
and here, so... the livestream inevitably 
ends up in the middle of the night... 
*yawn*...
choice_data_list: You wanted to see it live, huh...
You wanted to see it live, didn't you...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! If it's for that kind of thrill, a 
little sleepiness is nothing... 
*yaaawn*...
choice_data_list: リアルタイムで見たかったんだな……
リアルタイムで見たかったんだね……
choice_data_list_en: You really wanted to watch it live, huh...
You really wanted to watch it live, didn't you...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Chrono Genesis wasn't able to get 
much rest...
